title: BitGov Machine Authorization Projection V1 (MAS-I1 proving slice)
description: Structural schema for one top-level AuthorizationProjection object. Structural validation covers shape, required members, types, and unknown-field rejection only. Closed enum membership, version compatibility, conditional presence, and cross-field consistency are enforced by the semantic validator (reference_proving_slice.py), preserving the failure taxonomy: STRUCTURAL_MALFORMED vs SEMANTIC_INCONSISTENT vs VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE vs UNKNOWN_REQUIRED. Non-normative reference implementation; Python harness only.

mas_cr1_version.description: Concrete-representation tranche marker. Expected value '1'; compatibility checked semantically so mismatch classifies VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE.

schema_version.description: Projection schema version. Expected value '1'; compatibility checked semantically.

projection_identity.description: Opaque UUIDv7, lowercase canonical spelling. Opaque: NOT content-derived; distinct from governed-state, transport, SCM, and execution identities.

authorization_outcome.description: Closed set: AUTHORIZED | DENIED | NO-GOVERNED-DECISION | UNRESOLVED. Membership enforced semantically.

constitutional_disposition.description: Closed set: ADMISSIBLE | BLOCKED | UNRESOLVED. Conditionally present iff constitutional_applicability == APPLICABLE (semantic rule).

finality_aggregate.description: Closed set: FINAL | NOT_FINAL. Optional carrier; when present must agree with finality_vector (semantic rule).

lifecycle_state.description: Closed set: ACTIVE | SUPERSEDED | REVOKED | INVALIDATED | EXPIRED.

execution_reliance_effect.description: Closed set: RELIANCE_PERMITTED | RELIANCE_PROHIBITED | EFFECT_UNRESOLVED | EFFECT_NOT_APPLICABLE.

identity.description: Opaque governed identity. Compared by exact equality of parsed Unicode scalar sequence only: no NFC/NFKC, no case folding, no trimming, no locale normalization.
Opaque governed identity; exact opaque equality only.

governed_detail_reference.description: Optional governed detail reference permitted only on context/scope legs.

RequestBinding.description: Exact binding legs: principal, action, resource, context, scope.

Constraint.description: Carried enforcement constraint. constraint_type is an open string: the reference Aegis checker enforces only the TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY allowlist subtype and fails closed on any unknown subtype. The TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY subtype is harness-only and is NOT a normative BitGov enum, policy, or architecture addition.

statement.description: Opaque governed constraint statement carried for enforcement; never invented by GWO/Aegis.

restriction.description: Machine-checkable parameters; meaningful only for the TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY harness subtype.

GovernedProcessEffect.description: Carried governed appeal/escalation effect. Closed set: NOT_APPLICABLE | UNRESOLVED | ESTABLISHED.

AuthorityLineage.description: Closed CR1-R1 lineage: exact four members. Envelope references are never lineage; authority_reference / basis_reference are not valid substitutes.

TemporalEvaluationAndCurrency.description: evaluation_point is RFC3339 with explicit timezone/offset (shape checked semantically). currency_state closed set: CURRENCY_CURRENT | CURRENCY_STALE | CURRENCY_UNKNOWN_REQUIRED. temporal_bounds_reference is an opaque governed reference, required iff predicate_assertions.governed_temporal_rules_apply == TRUE. STALE currency is distinct from LifecycleState; no TTL, polling, or clock policy is specified.

ExecutionAgentIdentity.description: Present iff predicate_assertions.agent_specific == TRUE. Closed comparison methods: OPAQUE_EXACT | GOVERNED_RESOLVER. resolver_reference required iff method is GOVERNED_RESOLVER and absent iff OPAQUE_EXACT (semantic rule).

GovernedStateReference.description: Opaque governed-state reference. Governed-state identity != SCM identity; no hash/ledger/storage representation required.

PredicateAssertion.description: One predicate assertion. value closed set: TRUE | FALSE | UNRESOLVED. determination_reference always required. basis_unknown, when true, permitted only when value == UNRESOLVED. lineage (AuthorityLineage) always required.

PredicateAssertions.description: Always required; exactly these eight assertions. Conditional presence of projection fields is decided from these values, never from field presence, caller guess, or GWO/Aegis reconstruction.

AppealState.description: Opaque appeal state references; no governance effect inferred from filing/pendency. Present (with appeal_effect) iff predicate_assertions.appeal_applicability == TRUE.

EscalationState.description: Opaque escalation state references. Present (with escalation_effect) iff predicate_assertions.escalation_applicability == TRUE.

AbsenceEvidence.description: Closed CR1-R1 absence determination. finding closed set: GOVERNED_ABSENCE_FOUND | GOVERNED_ABSENCE_UNRESOLVED (membership enforced semantically). No caller prose assertion substitutes for this structure.

LifecycleTransition.description: Optional lifecycle transition record. Supsersession/revocation/invalidation semantics per governed rules; invalidation is not history deletion.
